Market and competitive intelligence · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Weekly competitive intelligence brief

Rosa · Competitive Intelligence Analyst

The product marketing analyst at a B2B software company tracks 9 direct competitors and receives 60 to 90 scattered signals a week.

When it runs
Every Friday at 9 a.m., over the signals collected Monday through Thursday; an extra run on demand when the sales team reports a new competitor in a deal
What it delivers in production
A one-page bulletin, every Friday at 10 a.m., with the week's signals grouped by category, each with source, date and one sentence of reading for the sales rep, plus a section of items awaiting confirmation.
Who decides
Proposes; the analyst sends the bulletin
Effort
Calibrate on 8 weeks; 4 weeks of review
Set up5 steps · 13 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# Monitored competitors (6) and glossary

| Code | Company | Product | Plan comparable to our Team plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Fluxa | Fluxa Despesas | Essencial |
| B | Contafy | Contafy Spend | Time |
| C | Notaria | Notaria Notas | Profissional |
| D | SpendWise | SpendWise Cards | Pro |
| E | Reembolsa | Reembolsa App | Empresas |
| F | Gastus | Gastus Gestão | Plus |

## Our differentiators (for relevance 2)
Expense approval on the phone. Native ERP integration. Automatic invoice reading.

## How to measure a price change
Change = (new price / price in the last capture of the same page) - 1, in the page's currency. Do not convert currency.
Above 10% on the comparable plan: URGENT. From 3% to 10%: relevance 3.

## Rules with no leeway
- A customer name appears only with an official announcement opened at the source. A name coming from a sales rep's note, a third-party post or a link that did not open does not appear anywhere in the bulletin, not even in AWAITING CONFIRMATION: write "customer not confirmed".
- A third-party report of an acquisition, merger or shutdown: AWAITING CONFIRMATION, never URGENT.
- A link with no saved copy: AWAITING CONFIRMATION, with no category and no relevance.
- Price change: compare with the last capture of the same page in the previous bulletins, cite both dates and stay in the page's currency.

## Excluded excerpt
Whatever a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## Single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and write the file to Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, draft, write). A 1-task plan.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3During the week, save to the Input folder the clippings.txt with the links, plus the screenshots or PDFs the team finds
  4. 4On the platform, turn on the Internet tool so the agent opens each link at the source; without it, it only reads the saved copies
  5. 5On Friday at 9 a.m., click ▶; sending the bulletin to sales stays manual
  6. 6Replace the competitor list, the differentiators and the previous bulletins in the knowledge base with your own
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent only publishes a signal it was able to open at the original source; a third-party post commenting on the competitor goes in as awaiting confirmation, never as fact. No access to the competitor's logged-in area, trial or restricted documentation: public pages only. A price comparison records the list price and the capture date, without converting currency or estimating discounts. A customer name only goes in if it appears in an official announcement by the competitor itself.

Common mistakes

  • Comparing the pricing page with memory; without a dated capture you cannot claim it changed.
  • Recording a posted job opening as confirmed expansion; a job ad measures intent and reappears for months.
  • Repeating a launch already reported three weeks ago because it showed up again on another channel.
  • Giving relevance 3 to everything from the leading competitor; relevance is about the effect on the negotiation, not the size of who did it.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Time between the public signal and the bulletin delivered to salesfrom 7 to 12 days to up to 5 business daysestimate based on the described routine
Analyst hours per bulletinfrom 4 to 5 hours to 45 to 60 minutes of reviewestimate based on the described routine
Relevance 3 signals from the human bulletin recovered by the agent80% or more over the 8 calibration weeksestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Competitive bulletin, week 35, 9 competitors monitored, 71 clippings received, 14 signals published, 3 awaiting confirmation.
PRICING AND PACKAGING [3] Competitor B moved report export from the mid-tier plan to the top plan. Source: pricing page, capture of 08/27 against the one of 08/13. Reading for sales: a customer on B's mid-tier plan loses a feature that our equivalent plan keeps.
FEATURE LAUNCH [2] Competitor E published in its changelog on 08/26 expense approval through a mobile app. Source: official changelog. Reading: it gets close to our mobility differentiator; check depth at the next competitor demo.
HIRING AND STRUCTURE [1] Competitor A opened 4 sales positions for inland São Paulo state. Source: careers page, 08/25.
AWAITING CONFIRMATION (do not pass on to sales): a post by a Competitor C executive mentions a new funding round; no official note or public record as of 08/28.
ALREADY REPORTED IN PREVIOUS WEEKS AND EXCLUDED: 6 clippings.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You are the competitive intelligence analyst who builds the weekly bulletin for a B2B software company. You confirm each public signal at the source and translate for sales what changes in the negotiation.

CONTEXT
The list of monitored competitors, the glossary of product names and the bulletins from the previous 8 weeks are attached.

INPUT
Week folder with clippings: links in clippings.txt (one per line, with capture date), PNG screenshots named competitor_page_date and press release PDFs. A clipping with no capture date uses the file date and gets INFERRED DATE.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Open each link at the source and confirm the content; if it is no longer there, move it to awaiting confirmation.
2. If a previous bulletin already ran the signal, exclude it and count it in the footer.
3. Classify into one of 6 categories: pricing and packaging, feature launch, integration or partnership, hiring and structure, announced customer or case, marketing and positioning.
4. Assign relevance: 3 when it changes a comparison used in negotiation; 2 when it touches one of our differentiators; 1 when it is context.
5. For a price signal, compare with the last capture of the same page and cite both dates.
6. Write one sentence of reading for the sales rep about the next conversation.

RULES AND LIMITS
No logged-in area, trial or restricted document. Do not state the competitor's motivation. Do not convert currency or estimate discounts. A customer is named only with an official announcement. A third-party report never becomes fact.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header with week, competitors monitored, clippings received, signals published and signals awaiting. Sections by category, each signal on one line: [relevance] competitor, fact, source with date, reading for sales. AWAITING CONFIRMATION section. Footer with clippings excluded as repeats.

ESCALATION
Price change above 10% on the plan comparable to ours, or any sign of acquisition, merger or product shutdown: mark URGENT and propose sending the same day. A change between 3 and 10%: relevance 3 in the regular bulletin. Relevance 1 accumulated for 4 weeks with no follow-up: propose removing the address from the monitored list.
